units.source_text: 金花自言自语，回忆起外国客人各种难以解释的行为。

en.t: Jinhua murmured to herself, recalling all sorts of inexplicable behavior by the foreign guest.

units.source_text: 当然，不用细想，他一定是趁着金花睡着的时候，偷偷溜走了。

en.t: Of course, without thinking about it too hard, he must have slipped away while Jinhua was asleep.

units.source_text: 但是他那样安抚她，她很难相信他不跟自己告别，就悄悄走掉。

en.t: But after he had soothed her like that, she found it hard to believe he would leave quietly without saying goodbye to her.

units.source_text: 不，与其说是不相信，不如说他是不忍心相信。

en.t: No, it was not so much that she did not believe it as that she could not bear to believe it.

units.source_text: 此外，她甚至忘了那个神奇的外国客人说好的十美金酬劳。

en.t: Besides, she had even forgotten the ten-dollar reward that marvelous foreign guest had promised.
